scope: Supplemental operating-console acceptance; canonical owners remain 264, 265, 266, 268, 64 and 68. This file defines cases, not executable tests or completed capabilities.

cases.given: Installed management service, enrolled operator and no product database
cases.when: Sign in, initialize and verify through the panel
cases.then: Database and loaded extension exist; exact generation and real Unicode/Highway readback are shown without SSH or ad hoc SQL
cases.falsifier: UI requires the missing product database to authenticate

cases.given: Existing database and authenticated operator
cases.when: Stop the managed database
cases.then: Console login, history, essential logs and scoped recovery remain available; ordinary data routes show unavailable
cases.falsifier: Database loss disables the only recovery interface or grants anonymous administration

cases.given: Approved exact replacement plan and sufficient staging capacity
cases.when: Recreate-and-seed from the UI
cases.then: New generation is staged, seeded, independently verified and explicitly activated; prior history remains inspectable
cases.falsifier: A successful worker exit is rendered as verified activation

cases.given: An active verified generation and a staged replacement
cases.when: Fail replacement schema or seed validation
cases.then: Replacement is not activated and prior generation remains unchanged where the staged provider permits
cases.falsifier: Validation failure silently resets the active generation

cases.given: Same reviewed confirmation and idempotency identity in two tabs
cases.when: Submit concurrently and retry after response loss
cases.then: One durable operation is admitted; changed payload conflicts; no duplicate destructive effect
cases.falsifier: Each POST performs another reset

cases.given: A pending destructive confirmation
cases.when: Change target generation, manifest, data impact or current authority
cases.then: Stale confirmation cannot authorize the changed effect
cases.falsifier: Confirmation binds only an action name or UI checkbox

cases.given: Recreation in progress
cases.when: Crash the worker before and after each effect boundary and lose the response
cases.then: Fenced recovery reconciles exact observed effect before retry or reports indeterminate; primary evidence survives
cases.falsifier: Unknown outcome triggers blind destructive replay

cases.given: Required protected backup fails or staging disk is insufficient
cases.when: Request recreation
cases.then: No protected destructive effect; precise corrective action and separately reviewed disposable alternative where policy allows
cases.falsifier: Automatic no-backup or in-place destructive fallback

cases.given: A selected backup with known source generation
cases.when: Restore into an isolated target and verify
cases.then: Readback establishes the declared recovery boundary; archive existence alone is not restore verification
cases.falsifier: A copied file passes recoverability acceptance

cases.given: Seed originals, other databases, management authority, audit and backup artifacts
cases.when: Recreate one enrolled database
cases.then: All out-of-scope state remains intact and old/new generation histories are distinct
cases.falsifier: Reset deletes a broad directory or the job journal

cases.given: A user whose grant was revoked after a backup
cases.when: Restore that older backup
cases.then: Surviving current revocation prevents restored stale authority from granting access
cases.falsifier: Backup rollback resurrects revoked sessions or roles

cases.given: Pinned Unicode plus two structurally unrelated configured source profiles
cases.when: Run from the same cockpit and inspect admitted results
cases.then: Shared lifecycle produces real canonical readback and source provenance for each boundary
cases.falsifier: Three private UI importers or fabricated fixtures substitute for shared admission

cases.given: Previously admitted exact source scope
cases.when: Reseed or retry already committed units
cases.then: Canonical state and independent testimony do not duplicate; new attempt provenance remains separately visible
cases.falsifier: Occurrence count becomes additional independent source support

cases.given: Manifest with a missing sidecar, bad digest or unavailable required provider
cases.when: Preflight and attempt declared admission
cases.then: Exact failing boundary is visible and whole-manifest completion cannot be claimed
cases.falsifier: Unprocessed input disappears from totals

cases.given: A source stage with known bytes and unknown output count
cases.when: Stream progress through parsing, persistence and closure
cases.then: Units, denominators and indeterminate stages remain separate; reading all bytes does not mean seeded
cases.falsifier: A global percentage reaches 100 before durable closure

cases.given: Versioned source schedule
cases.when: A new source release appears and a scheduled interval is missed
cases.then: Pinned update and missed-run policy controls the next run; no silent latest release or overlap
cases.falsifier: Scheduler globs latest directory contents

cases.given: One admitted long-running ingestion
cases.when: Close browser, sign out and reopen with authorized access
cases.then: Same operation, attempts, current stage and receipts are available with no implicit cancel or duplicate run
cases.falsifier: HTTP connection owns job lifetime

cases.given: Durable event cursor and snapshot
cases.when: Drop, duplicate, reorder and expire event history during reconnect
cases.then: Counters recover from authoritative snapshot/sequence and retention gap is explicit
cases.falsifier: Duplicate events double progress or expired events are silently invented

cases.given: A heartbeat-only stalled worker and a legitimately waiting job
cases.when: Inspect progress and alerts
cases.then: Last useful progress and blocking dependency distinguish stalled, waiting and active work
cases.falsifier: Heartbeat animates a false progress bar

cases.given: A failed stage followed by operator cancellation
cases.when: Open timeline and retry permitted failed scope
cases.then: Primary failure and prior attempt remain intact; retry is bounded and checkpoint-aware
cases.falsifier: Later cancellation erases failure evidence

cases.given: A one-line and a large log stream
cases.when: Search, select, scroll, pause display and expand the pane
cases.then: Visible bounded viewport, preserved selection/focus and no semantic rerun; output may continue while tail display is paused
cases.falsifier: Title-only panel, page growth without bounds or expansion reruns work

cases.given: Credential canaries and private content in scoped diagnostics
cases.when: Read, tail, export or deliver an alert as an unauthorized principal
cases.then: Access is denied or data redacted before publication; no secret canary reaches network payload, UI or export
cases.falsifier: Secret hidden by CSS but present in API response

cases.given: Healthy observed components and a changed loaded generation
cases.when: Stop a component, delay telemetry and introduce package mismatch
cases.then: Dependency-specific stale/unavailable/mismatch is visible with observation time
cases.falsifier: Last known green or process-alive certifies readiness forever

cases.given: Disk pressure, worker loss and repeated same-condition events
cases.when: Fire, acknowledge, silence and resolve alerts
cases.then: Condition lifecycle deduplicates, retains audit and never executes unrequested remediation
cases.falsifier: Acknowledgement clears actual unhealthy state or launches a script

cases.given: Approved load fixture with heavy ingest, large history and monitoring clients
cases.when: Measure status, cancellation acknowledgement, logs and login
cases.then: Reviewed latency/freshness and reserved-capacity budgets hold; expensive detail queries cannot trigger a retry storm
cases.falsifier: A single pathological receipt query saturates all control requests

cases.given: Viewer, seed operator, database administrator and scoped service principal
cases.when: Call privileged API/tool actions directly with forged scope or guessed object IDs
cases.then: Server and native effect authority enforce the same reviewed scope; inference credentials cannot reset a database
cases.falsifier: Hiding a button is the only permission check

cases.given: Enrolled SSO providers and a product database outage
cases.when: Use valid login, wrong issuer/audience, expired token, fake tenant header or unverified email link
cases.then: Only validated credential control and scoped mappings establish access; outage adds no privilege
cases.falsifier: Any signed JWT or matching email becomes administrator

cases.given: Primary console pages at desktop/narrow viewport and 200 percent zoom
cases.when: Complete initialize/seed/failure-recovery with keyboard and assistive technology
cases.then: Labels, focus, state changes and controls remain usable under the reviewed accessibility target
cases.falsifier: State indicated only by color or focus lost in expanding pane

cases.given: A new public operation and generated capability descriptor
cases.when: Deliver its backend, bindings and product surfaces
cases.then: Discoverable UI action/readback, auth, progress/errors/receipt and docs/acceptance evolve together
cases.falsifier: Backend marked delivered while its applicable operator path is absent

cases.given: Reviewed configuration change and enrolled target with known loaded package
cases.when: Apply/restart and test malicious target/path/command substitution
cases.then: Only typed authorized effects execute and exact loaded readback follows; arbitrary host execution is rejected
cases.falsifier: Management API accepts an unrestricted shell command or target path
